id: 7a8b9c0d-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries with high-entropy subdomains for known malicious domains, indicative of DNS tunneling.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/004/
author: SOC Team
logsource:
    category: dns_query
    product: firewall
    service: dns
detection:
    selection:
        query_type: TXT
        destination_domain|endswith: '.example.com'
        subdomain_entropy > 3.5
    known_c2_domain:
        destination_domain: "ns1.exfil-c2.example.com"
    condition: selection and known_c2_domain
fields:
    - timestamp
    - src_ip
    - query
    - subdomain_entropy
level: high

title: Lateral Movement via SMB to Critical File Server
id: 8b9c0d1e-2345-6789-01bc-def123456789
status: experimental
description: Detects successful SMB access from a host to a critical finance file server following a C2 beacon alert.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1021/002/
author: SOC Team
logsource:
    category: smb_access
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    selection:
        destination_host: 'FS-FIN-01'
        event_id: 5145
        share_name: '\\FS-FIN-01\Financials'
    c2_precedence:
        timeframe: 1h
        condition: selection | where host in (
            select host from events where event_id = 4688 and process_name = 'beacon.exe' and timestamp > now() - 1h
        )
    condition: selection and c2_precedence
fields:
    - timestamp
    - user
    - source_host
    - destination_host
level: critical

arguments.summary: A data exfiltration attempt was detected from workstation WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) to external IP 203.0.113.77 using DNS tunneling via the domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com. The domain is confirmed as associated with Cobalt Strike C2 infrastructure based on prior alerts. The source IP 203.0.113.77 has been previously observed conducting port scans. Investigation revealed that the compromised host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) was the origin of the C2 activity and exhibited lateral movement via SMB. Despite detection, containment actions were denied due to approval and parameter errors, indicating process gaps in incident response execution.

timeline.description: External IP 203.0.113.77 scanned internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Logged as low-severity scan.
Initial C2 beaconing detected from WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) to ns1.exfil-c2.example.com over HTTPS.
IDS alert triggered: 'ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity' from WS-FIN-042.
Lateral movement detected: WS-FIN-042 accessed file server 10.0.5.50 via SMB.
Data exfiltration alert: WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) sending 2.3GB via DNS tunnel to ns1.exfil-c2.example.com (203.0.113.77).
EDR query confirmed Chrome.exe as active process on WS-FIN-019; no direct malicious indicators found on endpoint.
SIEM correlation revealed historical C2 and lateral movement from WS-FIN-042, suggesting compromised credentials or malware.
Containment actions (firewall block, EPP isolation, IAM disable) were attempted but denied due to approval and parameter issues.

title: DNS Tunneling via High-Entropy TXT Queries to Known Malicious Domain
logsource:
  category: dns
  product: network
  service: dns_server
detection:
  selection:
    query_type: TXT
    query:
      - '*.*.exfil-c2.example.com'
      - '*.exfil-c2.example.com'
    bytes_outbound: '>1000'
  condition: selection
level: critical

  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/004/
falsepositives:

rule CobaltStrike_Metasploit_Shellcode_Detect {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common shellcode patterns used by Cobalt Strike and Metasploit"
        author = "SOC Team"
        date = "2026-04-10"
        hash = "d288a95c"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 00 60 00 60 00 60 00 60 00 60 00 60 00 60 00 } // XOR key patterns
        $b = "CryptStringToBinary" fullword ascii
        $c = { FF E0 } // JMP EAX
    condition:
        all of them
}

rule CobaltStrike_Metasploit_Shellcode_Detect {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common shellcode patterns used by Cobalt Strike and Metasploit"

    condition:
        all of them
